scenario.title: Evangelion Battle: Asuka
scenario.logline: Asuka faces her darkest demons as she battles an Angel and confronts a psychological crisis within NERV's walls.
scenario.synopsis: In the heart of Tokyo-3, Asuka grapples with her inner turmoil as she pilots Unit-02 against formidable Angels. As NERV braces for another impending attack, Asuka's sync ratio falters, pushing her to the brink of madness. With help from unlikely allies and a newfound determination, she must conquer her demons and protect humanity.

scenes: NERV briefing on the incoming Angel
Misato gives Asuka a pep talk
Asuka looks to the future with renewed resolve

scenario.visual_style: Hideaki Anno direction, bold colors, psychological tension, dramatic lighting
color_palette: Shadows and grays for psychological scenes
scenario.transmedia_notes: Potential spin-off manga, merchandise featuring Asuka, soundtrack album release on Crunchyroll
